{{Quote|Commander Neyo (CC-8826) and CT-3423, accompanying Allie on speeder bike reconnaissance, received Order 66 and fired on the Jedi with the cannons of the BARC speeder operated by the 91st. Several blasts hit the rear of Allie's Aratech 74-Z speeder bike, igniting its reactor and sending it into a fatal crash.|Moff Marcellin Wessel, reporting to Emperor Palpatine|<ref name="Order 66" />}}
'''Neyo''', also known by his number '''CC-8826''', was the name taken by an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Cloning/Legends|Cloned]] from the [[Clone template/Legends|template]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] on the [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Neyo was a graduate of ARC [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha's]] elite [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] [[ARC program/Legends|training program]]. Given the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|clone marshal commander]], Neyo became the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of the [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps/Legends|91st Reconnaissance Corps]], and in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] served in the five-[[Standard month/Legends|month]]-long [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|siege]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] planet [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. After the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] captured Saleucami, Neyo and his Reconnaissance Corps&mdash;under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]]&mdash;remained behind after the main Republic forces left, being tasked with destroying the last pockets of Separatist resistance.

During a [[BARC speeder/Legends|speeder]] patrol on Saleucami with [[General/Legends|General]] Allie and a fellow [[Troop/Legends|trooper]] designated [[CT-3423]], Neyo received [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]&mdash;a Republic [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|directive]] that labeled the [[Jedi/Legends|members]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as enemies of the Republic to be [[Death/Legends|executed]]&mdash;via his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. Neyo and 3423 followed through, killing their commanding [[Officer/Legends|officer]] with their [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]]' [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. After the execution of Order 66 and the Republic's [[New Order/Legends|transformation]] into the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Neyo retained his rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the new [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Biography==
===Early life and training===
Unit CC-8826<ref name="GGAR" /> was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]],<ref name="DB" /> [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] from the [[Clone template/Legends|template]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="DB Clones" /> After the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|initiation]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> in which the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] battled the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] for [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] supremacy,<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> 8826 served as an [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|377|Neyo, Commander}}</ref> 8826's purpose in life, along with those of<ref name="DB Clones" /> his<ref name="DB" /> clone brothers, was to fight for the Republic, being denied a chance to form his own feelings and ideas.<ref name="DB Clones" />

8826 was enrolled in ARC [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]] [[Alpha (Advanced Recon Commando)|Alpha's]] experimental [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]] [[ARC program/Legends|training program]] on Kamino, designed to give the Republic a new elite fighting force to combat the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. In this training camp, 8826 and the other clone [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Cadet/Legends|cadets]] began to develop their own personalities, encouraged by Alpha's unorthodox training methods, which allowed for more free thought and expression. CC-8826 himself took the name Neyo and became one of the coldest, most morbid members of his class. Neyo eventually graduated among the first hundred alumni of Alpha's program,<ref name="DB" /> being given the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|clone marshal commander]] and command over the GAR's [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps/Legends|91st Reconnaissance Corps]]. Neyo also maintained a close relationship with his fellow clone commander, the equally laconic [[Bacara/Legends|CC-1138]]&mdash;who took the name Bacara&mdash;who worked with Neyo to develop and test tactics in utilizing the Republic's newly-invented [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeders]] on the battlefield.<ref name="GGAR" />

===Missions during the Clone Wars===
[[File:Neyo_in_Temple.png|thumb|left|250px|CC-8826 in the Jedi Temple communications room]]
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">{{FactFile2014|58|DSQ 1-2|D-Squad}}</ref> 8826 escorted the [[DUM-series pit droid/Legends|pit droid]] [[WAC-47/Legends|WAC-47]]<ref name="SW">{{TCW|Secret Weapons}}</ref>&mdash;who served under him as part of the 91st Reconnaissance Corps<ref name="SWE-WAC-47">{{SWE|characters|wac-47|WAC-47}}</ref>&mdash;to a mission briefing in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi Temple communication center/Legends|communication center]]. Due to the droid's faulty hearing, they were late for the debriefing, interrupting the meeting as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] was going over the mission details with the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromechs]] [[M5-BZ/Legends|M5-BZ]], [[QT-KT/Legends|QT-KT]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and [[U9-C4/Legends|U9-C4]], all of whom comprised the [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]], led by the [[Zilkin/Legends|Zilkin]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]]. The commander left the meeting after Windu turned it over to Gascon, who disclosed more information regarding their [[Mission to steal a Separatist encryption module/Legends|mission]] to recover a Separatist [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]].<ref name="SW" />

CC-8826 later attended the [[Republic strategy conference/Legends|Republic strategy conference]] aboard the [[Valor (space station)/Legends|''Valor'']] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]] in order to discuss the ongoing war effort against the Separatists. The meeting was also attended by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] Mace Windu, Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Anakin Skywalker, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], and 8826's fellow clone commanders [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]] and [[Wolffe/Legends|CC-3636]]. A Separatist plot to [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotage]] the conference by ramming a [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] which was ridden with [[Rhydonium/Legends|rhydonium]] into the space station was foiled by Gascon and the D-Squad. One of the members, R2-D2, triggered the bomb before it crashed into the station, saving the lives of the Republic forces on the ''Valor''.<ref name="PoNR">{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}}</ref>

===Outer Rim Sieges and Order 66===
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Files">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=Commander Neyo (CC-8826)|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/93283/cid/6569482/2013-Topps-Star-Wars:-Galactic-Files-Series-2-456-Commander-Neyo}}</ref> Neyo and the 91st were assigned to [[Senior Jedi General]] [[Oppo Rancisis/Legends|Oppo Rancisis's]] command for the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|battle]] over the Separatist-controlled planet [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] during the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]]. Throughout the five-[[Standard month/Legends|month]]-long operation, Neyo worked alongside fellow clone commanders [[Faie/Legends|Faie]] and [[Bly/Legends|Bly]], leading the Republic's forces<ref name="DB" /> in destroying the Confederacy's [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Morgukai]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] cloning facilities on Saleucami.<ref name="SoS">[[Republic 79|''Republic'' 79]]</ref> After the defeat of the Separatists, Neyo and his reconnaissance units remained on-world while the majority of the Republic's forces departed the planet. Neyo and his men were placed under the leadership of Jedi [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]] and were tasked with patrolling for any remaining Separatist resistance or Morgukai warriors.<ref name="DB" />

[[File:91st_Recon_Corps.jpg|thumb|right|270px|CC-8826 (left) and CT-3423 (right) on Saleucami]]
While patrolling Saleucami's plains by twilight alongside General Allie and [[Troop/Legends|trooper]] [[CT-3423]] on [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeders]],<ref name="DB" /> Neyo received a call through his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]],<ref name="Episode III" /> a Republic [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency directive]] that declared the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] to be the Republic's enemies and mandated the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> After receiving his orders, Neyo motioned for CT-3423 and himself to fall behind Allie's [[74-Z speeder bike/Legends|74-Z speeder bike]].<ref name="Episode III" />

With their [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] directly in front of them, Neyo and CT-3423 opened [[Laser/Legends|fire]] on Allie with their BARC speeders' [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]];<ref name="Episode III" /> with Neyo's final shot, the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] ignited and sent the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] crashing into the ground,<ref name="Order 66" /> [[Death/Legends|killing]] Allie in the resulting explosion.<ref name="Episode III" /> Following the declaration of Order 66, the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] by Palpatine, who crowned himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]]. Neyo retained his rank of commander in the new [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], and later filed a report to Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Marcellin Wessel]] and [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine on the circumstances of Allie's death.<ref name="Order 66" />

==Personality and traits==
A clone bred for nothing beyond fighting and dying for the Republic, CC-8826 was not initially given a chance to develop his own feelings and beliefs.<ref name="DB Clones" /> However, in Alpha-17's unconventional clone commander training program, he was provided with the opportunity to form his own personality,<ref name="DB" /> taking the nickname "Neyo" and forming an attachment with his clone commander colleague Bacara.<ref name="GGAR" /> In the program, Neyo became one of the coldest and most unfeeling clones in his training class, adopting a laconic, almost morbid personality.<ref name="DB" /> He became an iconic member of the 91st Reconnaissance Corps, making a considerable reputation for himself.<ref name="CWA Shop: Neyo">{{TCWA|set=Commander Neyo}}</ref>

He was a loyal clone trooper, and when Chancellor Palpatine declared Order 66, he adhered to his master's wishes, killing General Stass Allie without a [[Standard second|second's]] hesitation. He was skilled in driving the Republic's BARC speeders,<ref name="Episode III" /> and worked with his friend Commander Bacara to develop revolutionary techniques in utilizing the BARC speeder in combat.<ref name="GGAR" /> Neyo stood at a height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="DB" /> and had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and tan skin. An [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] that read out his designation was located under his right cheek.<ref name="Black Series" />

==Skills and abilities==
The marshal commander was an extremely skilled fighter. He also possessed slightly above average strength, speed, and intelligence, and low diplomacy skills. Being a clone, Neyo was not [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]].<ref name="Galactic Files" />

==Equipment==
Neyo wore a style of [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]]<ref name="Episode III" /> similar to that which was used by the deadly [[clone assassin]]s of the GAR,<ref name="Episode III video game">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]]</ref> and wore a command sash on his [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was designated to ARCs. The armor had four symbols which labeled him a member of the 91st Reconnaissance Corps. The first of these symbols was on his helmet, while the second was located on his chestplate. The third and fourth symbols were located on the armor covering his right bicep and right thigh, respectively.<ref name="Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWOrder669.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A deleted animatic for Episode III]]
CC-8826 was created for the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="Episode III" /> released [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year by Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> Prior to the film's release, he was first mentioned in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'',<ref name="Visual Dictionary" /> published [[April 2]], [[2005]].<ref name="Cargo Bay">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/release/publishing/news20041124.html|text=Planning Your Episode III Bookshelf}}</ref> According to a [[2021]] tweet from [[Pablo Hidalgo]], the basis for the number "8826" came from his parents' landline number.<ref name="Pablo Tweet on Neyo">{{Twitter|pabl0hidalgo|status/1393811656908492806|[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|quote=Yes. And it became the basis of Clone Commander Neyo's number.|archivefile=File:Neyo-Number-Origin.png}}</ref> In the [[Star Wars video games|video game]]s ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]'' and the [[Wikipedia:PlayStation Portable|PSP]] version of ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'', there is an avatar wearing Neyo's Phase II armor in the games' customization features.<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref><ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>

The digital model used in ''Revenge of the Sith'' for Commander Neyo was originally designed to appear during the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] alongside Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. Initially, Neyo's digital model was to be a commander of an [[HAVw A6 Juggernaut/Legends|HAVw A6 Juggernaut]], and during the Order 66 scene, he was to order his [[Tank/Legends|tank]] to open fire on the [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-top command center above the battlefield that housed Yoda.<ref name="DB" />

This scene was cut, and the digital model was reassigned to a biker clone commander who carried out the execution of Stass Allie on Saleucami. Originally, the Saleucami clone was to be named "Faie"&mdash;after Art Department Supervisor [[Fay David]]&mdash;but the use of the Neyo model changed that commander's name. The Faie model was never used in the film, but did later appear in the comic story arc, ''[[Star Wars: Republic: Hidden Enemy]]''.<ref name="DB" />

[[File:Neyo_face.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Unused design of CC-8826's face from the episode "Secret Weapons"]]
[[Dave Filoni]], the Series Supervising Director for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, based Clone Commander [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]]'s new helmet visor on Neyo's helmet from ''Episode III'', for the episode "[[Mercy Mission (episode)|Mercy Mission]]," the fifth episode of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]].<ref name="Explore: Mercy Mission">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep405|text="Mercy Mission" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> Although not used in the episode "[[Secret Weapons]]," Neyo's face was given a design, which featured him sporting a tattoo of his clone designation in Aurebesh, on his left cheek.<ref name="SW-Secret Weapons - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep510|text="Secret Weapons" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> That facial design was incorporated into Neyo's action figure as part of a [[December]] [[2013]] wave of Hasbro's ''[[Star Wars: The Black Series]]'' collection.<ref name="Black Series" />
